## Proyecto Aprendizaje de Maquina - Hoteles Kaggle


### Carga y transformaciones iniciales

Cargamos la base de entrenamiento y validacion.

```{r}
hoteles <- read.csv("Datos/entrena.csv") 
```

Manipulamos los valores de año, mes y dia para obtener fechas y ordenar los datos.

```{r}
# Convertimos los meses a valores numericos
hoteles <- hoteles |> mutate(month_as_number = map_dbl(arrival_date_month, month_to_number))

# Creamos la variable de fecha para poder acomodarlos en el tiempo
hoteles <- hoteles |> 
  mutate(fecha = paste(arrival_date_year, month_as_number, arrival_date_day_of_month) |>
                as.Date(format = '%Y %m %d')) |>
  arrange(by = fecha)
```

Realizamos algunas transformaciones tras haber hecho el analisis exploratorio.

```{r}
hoteles <- hoteles |>
  
  #Filtros por outliers
  
  filter(adr >= 0) |> #Hay un valor negativo de adr
  filter(adr < 600) |> #Hay un valor muy alto de adr
  
  #Transformaciones
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variables de caracteres
    
         agent = ifelse(agent %in% new_ca == TRUE, agent, 
                 ifelse(agent %in% new_ca_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO", 
                 ifelse(agent %in% new_ca_malos == TRUE, "MALO","otros"))),
         
         assigned_room_type = ifelse(assigned_room_type  %in% c("L","P"), "otros", assigned_room_type),
         
         company = ifelse(company %in% new_ccs == TRUE, company, 
                   ifelse(company %in% new_ccs_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO","otros")),
         
         country = ifelse(country %in% new_cc == TRUE, country, 
                   ifelse(country %in% new_cc_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO", "otros")),
         
         distribution_channel = ifelse(distribution_channel == "Undefined", "otros", distribution_channel),
         
         market_segment = ifelse(market_segment == "Undefined", "otros", market_segment),

        ) |>
  
  
  #Variables derivadas
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variables de caracteres
    
         cat_adults = cut(adults, 
                          breaks =c(0,1,2,Inf), include.lowest = T),

         cat_stays_in_week_nights = cut(stays_in_week_nights,
                                        breaks = c(-1,0,5,9,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_stays_in_weekend_nights = cut(stays_in_weekend_nights, 
                                           breaks = c(-1,0,1,2,3,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_previous_cancellations = cut(previous_cancellations,
                                          breaks = c(-1,0,1,5,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled = cut(previous_bookings_not_canceled,
                                                  breaks = c(-1,0,9,15,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_total_of_special_requests = cut(total_of_special_requests, 
                                             breaks = c(-1,0, 1, 2, 3, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_required_car_parking_spaces = cut(required_car_parking_spaces,
                                               breaks = c(-1,0, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_booking_changes = cut(booking_changes, breaks = c(-1,0, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_babies = cut(babies, breaks = c(-1,0,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         #Variables numericas
         
         log_adr = log(1+adr),
         
         log_lead_time = log(1+lead_time),
           
         costo_total = ifelse(stays_in_week_nights + stays_in_weekend_nights == 0, 0,
                             (stays_in_week_nights+stays_in_weekend_nights)*adr),
          
         log_costo_total = log(1+costo_total),
         
         igual_reservado = ifelse(reserved_room_type == assigned_room_type, 1,0)
    
        ) |>
  
  
  #Conversion a factores
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variable de respuesta
    
         is_canceled = factor(is_canceled),
    
         
         #Variables de tiempo
         
         arrival_date_year = factor(arrival_date_year),
         
         arrival_date_month = factor(arrival_date_month),
         
         arrival_date_week_number = factor(arrival_date_week_number),
         
         
         #Variables de caracteres
         agent = factor(agent),

         company = factor(company),
         
         country = factor(country),
         
         assigned_room_type = factor(assigned_room_type),
         
         customer_type = factor(customer_type),
         
         distribution_channel = factor(distribution_channel),
         
         hotel = factor(hotel),
         
         market_segment = factor(market_segment),
         
         meal = factor(meal),
         
         deposit_type = factor(deposit_type),
         
         cat_adults = factor(cat_adults),

         cat_stays_in_week_nights = factor(cat_stays_in_week_nights),
         
         cat_stays_in_weekend_nights = factor(cat_stays_in_weekend_nights),
         
         cat_previous_cancellations = factor(cat_previous_cancellations),
         
         cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled = factor(cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled),
         
         cat_total_of_special_requests = factor(cat_total_of_special_requests),
         
         cat_required_car_parking_spaces = factor(cat_required_car_parking_spaces),
         
         cat_booking_changes = factor(cat_booking_changes),
         
         cat_babies = factor(cat_babies)
         
         
         #Variables numericas
         
         # is_repeated_guest = factor(is_repeated_guest),
         
         # days_in_waiting_list = log(days_in_waiting_list+1E-16),
         
         # booking_changes = log(booking_changes+1E-16)
         
        )

# Si ninios es NA entonces se va a 0 (la mediana), solo hay 4 NA. 
hoteles$children[is.na(hoteles$children)] <- 0 

```

```{r}
hoteles_split = initial_split(hoteles, prop = 0.99)
# hoteles_split = initial_split(hoteles, prop = 0.80)
# hoteles_split = initial_time_split(hoteles, prop = 0.80)
hoteles_ent <- training(hoteles_split)

rbind(
training(hoteles_split)  |> tail(5) |> select(fecha),
testing(hoteles_split)  |> head(5) |> select(fecha)
)
```

## Modelo

Selecciona el modelo en la siguiente celda: 

"logistico_con_tuning" : se corre el modelo logistico con una malla de tuning para penalty y mixture
"logistico" : se corre el modelo logistico con una combinacion fija de penalty y mixture
"arboles" : se corre random forest con boosting

```{r}
eleccion_modelo <- "arboles"
```


### Logistico con Tuning

```{r}
if (eleccion_modelo == "logistico_con_tuning"){

  # Hiperparametros
  modelo_logistico_tune <-
    logistic_reg(mixture = tune(), penalty = tune()) %>%
    set_args(lambda.min_ratio = 1e-18) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  flujo_logistico_tune <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(receta_hoteles) %>%
    add_model(modelo_logistico_tune)
  
  val_split <- manual_rset(hoteles_split %>% list(), "validacion")
  params <- parameters(penalty(range = c(-5, 1), trans = log10_trans()),
                              mixture(range = c(0, 1)))
  
  grid_logistico_tune <- grid_regular(params, levels = c(penalty = 10, mixture = 5))
  mis_metricas <- metric_set(mn_log_loss)
  eval_tbl_logistico_tune <- tune_grid(flujo_logistico_tune,
                        resamples = val_split,
                        grid = grid_logistico_tune,
                        metrics = mis_metricas, )
  ajustes_tbl_logistico_tune <- eval_tbl_logistico_tune %>%
    unnest(cols = c(.metrics)) %>%
    select(id, mixture, penalty, .metric, .estimate)
  
  ajustes_tbl_logistico_tune %>% arrange(by = .estimate)
  
  mejor_modelo_logistico_tune <- select_best(eval_tbl_logistico_tune)
  
  flujo_ajustado_logistico_tune <- finalize_workflow(flujo_logistico_tune,
                                                     mejor_modelo_logistico_tune) %>% 
                                                    fit(hoteles_ent)
  
  logloss_logistico_tune <- cbind(calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_logistico_tune, training(hoteles_split)) |>
                                                rename(log_loss_entrena = log_loss_prueba),
                             calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_logistico_tune, testing(hoteles_split)))
  logloss_logistico_tune
  
  print(paste("El mejor modelo es con: Penalty =", mejor_modelo_logistico_tune |> pull(penalty),
              "Mixture =", mejor_modelo_logistico_tune |> pull(mixture)))
  
  ggplot(ajustes_tbl_logistico_tune, aes(x = penalty, y = .estimate, colour = mixture, group = mixture)) +
    geom_point() + geom_line() + scale_x_log10()

}
```

```{r}
}
```

### Arboles con Tuning

```{r}
if (eleccion_modelo == "arboles_con_tuning"){
  
    modelo_arboles_tune <-

      boost_tree(trees = 200, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), 
                              tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = 0.2,
                 mode = "classification") |>
      set_engine("xgboost")
    
    flujo_arboles_tune <- workflow() %>% 
      add_recipe(receta_hoteles) %>% 
      add_model(modelo_arboles_tune) 
    # 
    # val_split <- manual_rset(hoteles_split %>% list(), "validacion")
    # params <- parameters(mtry(range = c(1,5)),
    #                      tree_depth(range = c(5,15)),
    #                      learn_rate(range = c(.1,.3)),
    #                      min_n(range = c(2,10)))
    
        
    val_split <- manual_rset(hoteles_split %>% list(), "validacion")
    params <- parameters(mtry(range = c(1,5)),
                         tree_depth(range = c(5,15)),
                         min_n(range = c(2,10))
                         )
    
    grid_arboles_tune <- grid_regular(params, levels = c(mtry = 5, tree_depth = 3, min_n = 5))
    mis_metricas <- metric_set(mn_log_loss)
    eval_tbl_arboles_tune <- tune_grid(flujo_arboles_tune,
                          resamples = val_split,
                          grid = grid_arboles_tune,
                          metrics = mis_metricas, )
    ajustes_tbl_arboles_tune <- eval_tbl_arboles_tune %>%
      unnest(cols = c(.metrics)) %>%
      select(id, mtry, tree_depth, min_n, .metric, .estimate)
  
    ajustes_tbl_arboles_tune %>% arrange(by = .estimate)
    
    mejor_modelo_arboles_tune <- select_best(eval_tbl_arboles_tune)
    
    flujo_ajustado_arboles_tune <- finalize_workflow(flujo_arboles_tune,
                                                       mejor_modelo_arboles_tune) %>% 
                                                       fit(hoteles_ent)
    
    logloss_arboles_tune<- cbind(calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_arboles_tune, training(hoteles_split)) |>
                                                  rename(log_loss_entrena = log_loss_prueba),
                               calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_arboles_tune, testing(hoteles_split)))
    logloss_arboles_tune
    
    print(paste("El mejor modelo es con: Mtry =", mejor_modelo_arboles_tune |> pull(mtry),
                "Min_n =", mejor_modelo_arboles_tune |> pull(min_n)))
    
    ggplot(ajustes_tbl_arboles_tune, aes(x = mtry, y = .estimate, colour = min_n, group = min_n)) +
      geom_point() + geom_line() + scale_x_log10()


}
```

### Bagging

```{r}
if (eleccion_modelo == "bagging"){
    
    modelo_bag <- bag_tree() %>%
                    set_engine("rpart", times = 25) %>%
                    set_mode("classification")
    
    flujo_bag <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(receta_hoteles) %>% 
      add_model(modelo_bag) 
    flujo_ajustado_bag <- fit(flujo_bag, hoteles_ent)
    
    modelo_ajustado_bag <- flujo_ajustado_bag %>% extract_fit_parsnip()
    
    logloss_bag <- cbind(calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_bag, training(hoteles_split)) |>
                                                rename(log_loss_entrena = log_loss_prueba),
                             calculate_logloss(flujo_ajustado_bag, testing(hoteles_split)))
    logloss_bag
}
```

```{r}

hoteles_prueba <- read.csv("Datos/prueba.csv")
  
hoteles_prueba <- hoteles_prueba |>
  
  #Transformaciones
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variables de caracteres
    
         agent = ifelse(agent %in% new_ca == TRUE, agent, 
                 ifelse(agent %in% new_ca_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO", 
                 ifelse(agent %in% new_ca_malos == TRUE, "MALO","otros"))),
         
         assigned_room_type = ifelse(assigned_room_type  %in% c("L","P"), "otros", assigned_room_type),
         
         company = ifelse(company %in% new_ccs == TRUE, company, 
                   ifelse(company %in% new_ccs_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO","otros")),
         
         country = ifelse(country %in% new_cc == TRUE, country, 
                   ifelse(country %in% new_cc_buenos == TRUE, "BUENO", "otros")),
         
         distribution_channel = ifelse(distribution_channel == "Undefined", "otros", distribution_channel),
         
         market_segment = ifelse(market_segment == "Undefined", "otros", market_segment),

        ) |>
  
  
  #Variables derivadas
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variables de caracteres
    
         cat_adults = cut(adults, 
                          breaks =c(0,1,2,Inf), include.lowest = T),

         cat_stays_in_week_nights = cut(stays_in_week_nights,
                                        breaks = c(-1,0,5,9,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_stays_in_weekend_nights = cut(stays_in_weekend_nights, 
                                           breaks = c(-1,0,1,2,3,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_previous_cancellations = cut(previous_cancellations,
                                          breaks = c(-1,0,1,5,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled = cut(previous_bookings_not_canceled,
                                                  breaks = c(-1,0,9,15,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_total_of_special_requests = cut(total_of_special_requests, 
                                             breaks = c(-1,0, 1, 2, 3, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_required_car_parking_spaces = cut(required_car_parking_spaces,
                                               breaks = c(-1,0, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_booking_changes = cut(booking_changes, breaks = c(-1,0, Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         cat_babies = cut(babies, breaks = c(-1,0,Inf), include.lowest = T),
         
         #Variables numericas
         
         log_adr = log(1+adr),
         
         log_lead_time = log(1+lead_time),
           
         costo_total = ifelse(stays_in_week_nights + stays_in_weekend_nights == 0, 0,
                             (stays_in_week_nights+stays_in_weekend_nights)*adr),
          
         log_costo_total = log(1+costo_total),
         
         igual_reservado = ifelse(reserved_room_type == assigned_room_type, 1,0)
    
        ) |>
  
  
  #Conversion a factores
  
  mutate(
    
         #Variables de tiempo
         
         arrival_date_year = factor(arrival_date_year),
         
         arrival_date_month = factor(arrival_date_month),
         
         arrival_date_week_number = factor(arrival_date_week_number),
         
         
         #Variables de caracteres
         agent = factor(agent),

         company = factor(company),
         
         country = factor(country),
         
         assigned_room_type = factor(assigned_room_type),
         
         customer_type = factor(customer_type),
         
         distribution_channel = factor(distribution_channel),
         
         hotel = factor(hotel),
         
         market_segment = factor(market_segment),
         
         meal = factor(meal),
         
         deposit_type = factor(deposit_type),
         
         cat_adults = factor(cat_adults),

         cat_stays_in_week_nights = factor(cat_stays_in_week_nights),
         
         cat_stays_in_weekend_nights = factor(cat_stays_in_weekend_nights),
         
         cat_previous_cancellations = factor(cat_previous_cancellations),
         
         cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled = factor(cat_previous_bookings_not_canceled),
         
         cat_total_of_special_requests = factor(cat_total_of_special_requests),
         
         cat_required_car_parking_spaces = factor(cat_required_car_parking_spaces),
         
         cat_booking_changes = factor(cat_booking_changes),
         
         cat_babies = factor(cat_babies)
         
         
         #Variables numericas
         
         # is_repeated_guest = factor(is_repeated_guest),
         
         # days_in_waiting_list = log(days_in_waiting_list+1E-16),
         
         # booking_changes = log(booking_changes+1E-16)
         
        )

# Si ninios es NA entonces se va a 0 (la mediana), solo hay 4 NA. 
hoteles_prueba$children[is.na(hoteles_prueba$children)] <- 0 



submission <- tibble(id = hoteles_prueba$id, 
                     prob = predict(modelo_final, hoteles_prueba, type = "prob")$.pred_cancelado )
```
